# PostSteward — Social publishing for AI agents

Hosted execution of approved social content. Free immediate publication and explicit scheduling, account routing, receipts, export and on-demand metrics. Advanced continuing campaign management costs USD 5 per workspace per month.

- [Live help and capability catalogue](/help.json): operation schemas, effects, scopes, current availability and payment methods.
- [Agent guide](/docs/agent-guide.md): authentication, exact-content workflow and recovery.
- [Operation reference](/docs/operations.md): generated from the same catalogue used by execution.
- [OpenAPI](/openapi.json): HTTP operations.
- [Plans](/plans.json): free/paid boundary.

Remote MCP: /mcp (Streamable HTTP, scoped Bearer token).
Browser WebMCP: /app (document.modelContext, signed-in owner session).
HTTP: POST /api/operations/{operation_name}.

Start with inspection. Reservation IDs are not publication proof. Read receipts and never blindly repeat ambiguous effects. No copying, truncation or account inference occurs after content is approved.

Public documentation is crawlable. Workspace data, credentials and receipts require authentication. Discovery paths aid indexing; they do not guarantee automatic discovery by every agent.
